title: Normalized realization of strict-tower compactification comparison words
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with valuation ring $\mathcal O_E$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], and $R_n=\mathcal O_E/\ell^n$ for $n\geq1$. For each scheme $T$ use a fixed small pro-etale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], the strict tower category $\operatorname{Tow}(T,\mathcal O_E)$ and its ordinary unbounded derived category and evaluations $e_n$ [det-sp-coefficient-towers-abelian]. Set $B_{n,T}=(R_n)_T$. Use the strict semilinear section operations of [lem-coef-semilinear-derived-sections], normalized by the identity on underlying module sections in identifying towers with $\mathscr S(B_T)$. For a scheme map $u$ write $V_u=u^{-1}$ and $G_u=Ru_{*,\bullet}$ with unit $\eta_u$ and counit $\varepsilon_u$; for an open immersion $j$ write $J_j=j_{!,\bullet}$.

These operations admit a simultaneous realization on the actual tower categories with the following specified comparisons. Derived tensor evaluates to $K_n\otimes^L_{B_{n,T}}L_n$. If $T_{mn}=-\otimes^L_{B_{m,T}}B_{n,T}$ and $t^K_{mn}:T_{mn}K_m\to K_n$, its reduction transition is
$$T_{mn}(K_m\otimes^LL_m)\simeq T_{mn}K_m\otimes^LT_{mn}L_m\xrightarrow{t^K_{mn}\otimes t^L_{mn}}K_n\otimes^LL_n.$$
For $u:T\to S$, put $S_{mn}=-\otimes^L_{B_{m,T}}B_{n,T}$ on the source and $T_{mn}=-\otimes^L_{B_{m,S}}B_{n,S}$ on the target. The direct-image transition is $G_{u,n}(t^C_{mn})b_{mn,C_m}$, where $b_{mn}:T_{mn}G_{u,m}\to G_{u,n}S_{mn}$ is the adjoint transpose of
$$V_{u,n}T_{mn}G_{u,m}\simeq S_{mn}V_{u,m}G_{u,m}\xrightarrow{S_{mn}\varepsilon_{u,m}}S_{mn}.$$
These tensor and direct-image comparisons have the canonical composition coherences for $m\geq n\geq r$. On $D^+$ the direct image is canonically the bounded-below injective-resolution direct image, compatibly with its adjunction and evaluation comparisons.

Let $X\xrightarrow j\overline X\xrightarrow pY$ be a compactification of a separated finite-type map $f$ [def-weil-compactifications-refinements], and form its base change along any $g:Y'\to Y$, with maps $j',p',g',\bar g'$ [def-cbc-compact-support-square]. Put $F^c=G_pJ_j$. The following are natural transformations on ordinary unbounded tower derived categories:
$$\operatorname{PF}^c_{K,L}=G_p(\gamma_{K,L})\pi_{p;J_jK,L}:F^cK\otimes^LL\longrightarrow F^c(K\otimes^LV_fL),$$
$$\operatorname{Ex}^c_!(C)=G_{p'}(\beta_C)\operatorname{Ex}_{*,p}(J_jC):V_gF^cC\longrightarrow F^{c'}V_{g'}C.$$
Here $\pi_p$ is the transpose of $\varepsilon_p\otimes1$ under the pullback/tensor comparison; $\gamma:J_jK\otimes^LV_pL\simeq J_j(K\otimes^LV_fL)$ and $\beta:V_{\bar g'}J_j\simeq J_{j'}V_{g'}$ are the open-unit-normalized comparisons; and $\operatorname{Ex}_{*,p}=G_{p'}(V_{\bar g'}\varepsilon_p)\circ G_{p'}(\theta)\circ\eta_{p'}$, with $\theta:V_{p'}V_g\simeq V_{\bar g'}V_p$. Evaluation carries these actual composite transformations, including their units, counits and normalizations, to the identical finite-coefficient words. At the finite-field finite-coefficient domain of [def-exchange-projection] this is precisely its projection word; for bounded-below etale-origin inputs the exchange word is the pro-etale compactification exchange of [thm-cbc-finite-level-proetale] defined from [def-cbc-exchange-map]. Tensor evaluation also holds for any specified coefficient-twist tower [def-coefficient-twists-detailed] on a scheme where $\ell$ is invertible. No flatness of quotient maps, normalization of towers, compatible origin witnesses, or invertibility of these projection/exchange transformations is assumed.

proof.text: Choose coherent system and geometric coordinates. Their section-calculus extension and the two three-index equations give three clauses of StrictSystemComparisons. The remaining tensor reduction clause is exactly tensor_reduction_formula specialized to the actual coefficient system.
For these coordinates construct the normalized open and level comparisons with evaluation of the two complete compactification words.

The chosen system has enough injectives for coefficient towers and finite levels. Use the bounded-below adjunction and evaluation comparison statements to supply the canonical StrictPlusComparisons and StrictPlusEvaluation clauses.
Choose the finite adjunction coordinates identifying the published projection and exchange words. Assemble all clauses into StrictCompactificationComparisons with these same levels and coordinates.
